title: Level 2: A project: subprograms and aspects

tests.name: b01_apply_aspect
tests.title: apply runs the main process of an aspect from asp/ and waits

tests.name: b01_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b01: the same aspect, called in a loop with a computed argument

tests.name: b02_apply_output
tests.title: an aspect gives results back through @ output parameters

tests.name: b02_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b02: results used as inputs, in a loop

tests.name: b03_apply_state
tests.title: each apply creates a new state of the aspect: a second call sees nothing of the first

tests.name: b03_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b03: three applies, three fresh states

tests.name: b04_apply_named_args
tests.title: apply with arguments by position, by name and with a default value

tests.name: b04_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b04: every argument by name, in another order

tests.name: b05_apply_spread
tests.title: spreading a list into positional arguments and a map into named arguments ( i)

tests.name: b05_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b05: spread of a whole list and of a whole map

tests.name: b06_aspect_error
tests.title: an error not recovered in the aspect is raised in the primary aspect at the apply line

tests.name: b06_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b06: the error code of the aspect is the code of the raise

tests.name: b07_aspect_over
tests.title: over in an aspect ends the aspect; the primary aspect goes on after apply

tests.name: b07_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b07: over in the aspect twice: the primary aspect goes on each time

tests.name: b08_aspect_panic
tests.title: panic in an aspect ends the whole application with exit code 1

tests.name: b08_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b08: panic ends the application: the finalize of the primary aspect does not run

tests.name: b09_log_files
tests.title: log_err and log_wrn write log files in the output folder out/

tests.name: b10_aspect_function
tests.title: a function declared in an aspect is used by its main

tests.name: b10_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b10: the function of the aspect with its default and by name

tests.name: b11_aspect_procedure
tests.title: a procedure of an aspect changes an aspect-level variable; the primary aspect's own variable is not touched

tests.name: b11_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b11: the state of the aspect is new in every call

tests.name: b12_aspect_fresh_state
tests.title: main and the procedures of an aspect share its variables, and every apply starts them again

tests.name: b12_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b12: the list of the aspect is new in every call, in a loop

tests.name: b13_aspect_missing
tests.title: apply of an aspect that has no file is an error before the run

tests.name: b14_aspect_too_many_args
tests.title: more positional arguments than parameters is a check-time error

tests.name: b14_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b14: the right call: two arguments, then one

tests.name: b15_aspect_apply_aspect
tests.title: an aspect may apply another aspect, by its name (it was a compile error with)

tests.name: b16_aspect_recover
tests.title: an aspect recovers its own error: the primary aspect never sees it

tests.name: b16_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b16: the aspect recovers its own error, twice

tests.name: b17_aspect_trace
tests.title: an error nobody recovers: the error first, then the frames in order of call

tests.name: b18_lambda
tests.title: a lambda is an anonymous function: held by a name, passed as an argument, held by a function type

tests.name: b19_closure
tests.title: a closure keeps the state of the function that made it; every apply makes new closures

tests.name: b20_aspect_unknown_param
tests.title: an argument named like no parameter is a check-time error

tests.name: b20_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b20: the right name of the optional parameter

tests.name: b21_aspect_missing_arg
tests.title: a missing mandatory argument is a check-time error

tests.name: b21_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b21: the mandatory argument by name

tests.name: b22_aspect_wrong_type
tests.title: an argument of the wrong type is a check-time error

tests.name: b23_aspect_default_exclusive
tests.title: an aspect without a kind word is exclusive

tests.name: b24_aspect_second_process
tests.title: an aspect may have a second process: a private one, called by its own main (it was an error with)

tests.name: b25_aspect_driver_variable
tests.title: an aspect can't read a variable of the primary aspect

tests.name: b26_aspect_finalize
tests.title: finalize of an aspect runs when main ends, also by over; then the primary aspect goes on

tests.name: b26_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b26: finalize in a loop, by return and by over

tests.name: b27_aspect_concurrent
tests.title: a concurrent aspect can also be applied, one call after the other

tests.name: b27_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b27: a concurrent aspect applied with other texts

tests.name: b28_aspect_folder
tests.title: apply with a folder: the aspect is searched there first, then in asp/ and in the root

tests.name: b28_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b28: only the aspect of the default folder

tests.name: b29_aspect_output_named
tests.title: an @ output parameter that follows optional parameters is named at the call

tests.name: b29_test1
tests.title: variation 1 of b29: the default exponent, then both by name

tests.name: b30_function
tests.title: functions: result, named arguments, default values, several results

tests.name: b31_procedure
tests.title: procedures: no result, side effects, @ passes by reference, no @ passes a copy

tests.name: b32_recursion
tests.title: a function can call itself: Fibonacci (from demo/fibonacci.eve)

tests.name: b33_function_without_result
tests.title: a function must have a result: a subprogram without result is declared with procedure

tests.name: b34_procedure_bang
tests.title: a procedure is made for side effects and is never deterministic: it never ends with !

tests.name: b35_exit_procedure
tests.title: exit in a procedure leaves only the procedure; the process goes on

tests.name: b36_over_procedure
tests.title: over in a procedure ends the whole process, not only the procedure

tests.name: b37_param_order
tests.title: a mandatory parameter may follow optional ones, and the call then names it

tests.name: b38_named_required
tests.title: a parameter after optional parameters can't be positional: the call must name it

tests.name: b39_vararg_function
tests.title: a vararg collects the rest of the arguments; an optional parameter after it is named

tests.name: b40_procedure_in_expression
tests.title: a procedure has no value: it can't be used in an expression

tests.name: b41_variant_params
tests.title: a variant type holds one of the listed types and takes the type of the value assigned (from demo/variant_type.eve and demo/variant_params.eve)

tests.name: b42_defer_procedure
tests.title: defer in a procedure runs when the procedure ends, by any path, in reverse order

tests.name: b43_vararg_procedure
tests.title: a vararg parameter collects the arguments of a procedure; * spreads a list into it

tests.name: b44_lambda_call
tests.title: a lambda is not called where it is written: it gets a name, then the name is called

tests.name: b45_primary_not_applied
tests.title: no aspect applies a primary aspect: it is run by a command

tests.name: b46_three_levels
tests.title: an aspect calls an aspect that calls a third one: three levels

tests.name: b47_aspect_cycle
tests.title: a chain of calls that comes back to an aspect is a compile error

tests.name: b48_aspect_self_call
tests.title: an aspect can't call itself

tests.name: b49_four_levels
tests.title: the chain of calls is at most three levels deep

tests.name: b50_private_process
tests.title: a private process is applied by its bare name, in the aspect that declares it

tests.name: b51_private_process_state
tests.title: the private processes of a call share the state of the aspect

tests.name: b52_dot_on_aspect
tests.title: the dot is never applied to an aspect: only main is public

tests.name: b53_no_main
tests.title: an aspect without a process main can't be applied

tests.name: b54_run_exclusive
tests.title: a command runs an exclusive aspect alone, for testing

tests.name: b55_function_recover
tests.title: a function and a procedure can have a recover region: the error is handled inside, the caller goes on

tests.name: b56_recover_result
tests.title: when recover ends, the function returns its result variables as they are: the zero value if recover sets nothing

tests.name: b57_recover_propagates
tests.title: an error raised in recover goes to the caller; abort passes the same error on; the caller's recover sees it

tests.name: b58_recover_retry_refused
tests.title: retry and resume need a failed job: in the recover of a function they are a run-time error

tests.name: b59_generator_no_recover
tests.title: a generator has no recover region: it is a compile error

tests.name: b60_cfg_setup
tests.title: -e file.cfg sets system variables: lines $name = literal, # comments, an Integer, a Real, a Logic and a String

tests.name: b61_cfg_bad_line
tests.title: a configuration file with a bad line stops the run before it starts: exit 65 and the line

tests.name: b62_cfg_setup_command
tests.title: the REPL command setup checks a configuration file and keeps it for the next runs; a missing file is reported
